title: Application of Cambridge Electric Light Company under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 384, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the Power Cost Charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant ot meter reading in the billing month of March, 1986. Application is also made by Cambridge Electric Light Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and M.D.P.U. 386. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department, and implement the intent of section 201 and 210 of the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
